pages.text: $(bold)Water washes Sweaty Feet; medicinal water cures fungus.$()$(br2)Soaking in water washes it - higher levels take longer; wearing boots while in water just gets you told to take them off.$(br2)The wash basin is a picky container - for how it actually works, go figure it out in "Mechanics → Using the Wash Basin".

When done: Sweaty Feet (and fungus, if medicinal) is cured, and the basin water turns $(bold)dirty$() - scoop it up with an empty bucket.$(br2)$(bold)Degrading$(): after taking boots off, Sweaty Feet drops one level every so often (host-adjustable) down to level 1, then stays - $(bold)only washing fully clears it$().
